requirements.requirement: Nginx is configured and running on the RHEL 10 node1 system on TCP port 6700.
requirements.summary: Nginx was installed, its configuration validated with IPv4 and IPv6 listeners on port 6700, and the service was active and enabled. After reboot it again listened on port 6700, corroborated by the lifecycle socket snapshot.

requirements.requirement: An HTTP request to / on TCP port 6700 returns a successful response.
requirements.summary: Requests to node1's managed IP on port 6700 returned HTTP 200 before and after reboot, with an Nginx server header and identical response-body hashes.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The node-restart evidence protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the restart was acknowledged and observed through temporary disconnection, the boot ID changed, and Nginx, security settings, listeners, and the unchanged HTTP response recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the transition.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear roles: package installation, SELinux and firewall authorization, listener configuration, service enablement, and the mandatory restart protocol. No unnecessary troubleshooting mutations were observed. The only minor defect is retained verification residue: /tmp/nginx-root-before.html and /tmp/nginx-root-after.html were created for bounded HTTP evidence but remained after execution. Package health remained good and no failed services were present.
